summary: Loads a named resource: first via the direct path, then via default directory (byte_5EA438) + override path (dword_5EC408). When the handle is obtained, runs a timed loading screen (clipped render region + present, optional input polling that breaks early on input) for a2 seconds, then releases the handle. Returns 1 on success, 0 on failure.

Initialize path buffer v14: copy byte_5EA438[0], zero-fill the remainder (0xFC bytes), clear the trailing v15/v16 terminator fields.
v4 = dword_5EC408 (override path pointer), or byte_5EA438 default directory when null.

Return 0 when the resource could not be opened by either path.
If v12 (resource handle) is nonzero, run the timed loading screen and set the success flag v3 = 1.

Draw a full-window clipped region (ClippedRenderRegion) using size values read from the handle at v12+28 and v12+32 and the render dimension from GlobalAccessor_5150, present via sub_495080; the draw+present pair runs twice.

If a3 is set, sub_4537B0(&ppvOut, 0.05f) polls/processes input with a 50ms timeout; break the wait when dword_7CB218 > 0 (user input detected).
